info.title: PlaneMem current session source read
info.description: Existing POST current-only observation, TODO P0-01 source increment. Load standalone session-current schema plus context-history HTTP components locally. No validators/generators/runtime/release evidence. Separate session-origin public proof route is outside this file.

servers.description: Relative Gateway base; configure deployment origin/base.

x-runtime-boundaries.request: Before authentication, read raw body<=4096 bytes, decode fatal UTF-8 (BOM preserved and therefore rejected by JSON.parse), require flat nonarray object with all values strings and case-insensitively unique decoded names. Then exact five fields/protocol/configuration/ULID/digest checked in reader. Unknown fields and target/configuration mismatch are INVALID_REQUEST_CONTEXT400. Duplicate/alias/invalid/empty/nested/oversized body is INVALID_JSON400, not413. No dedicated ingress body timeout.
x-runtime-boundaries.headers: Requires signed Bearer/OIDC, actual client and scope headers matching verified claims or configured complete Workbench scope. Raw actor/client/capability headers do not grant identity. Optional expected actor/client each checked against verified identity. Nonempty x-trace-id wins over traceparent, otherwise generated trace_http_<ULID>; no W3C traceparent parsing. Selected success trace must be bounded512/control-free. Query, Content-Type, Content-Encoding, Range/cache/write-condition headers have no dedicated rejection here; raw bytes are not decompressed. This path does not enter readPreconditions, so Idempotency-Key and version headers have no CAS/replay effect.
x-runtime-boundaries.configuration: Reader exists only with auditDb and explicit endpoint/configuration. Missing reader or authority503. Optional session_current_opa requires configuration, real OIDC and no alternate session_current_authority. Origin authority additionally requires DB/current OPA. No default allowing authority and no in-memory fallback. Deployment values/approval must be supplied separately.
x-runtime-boundaries.authorization: Entry and post-read router policy require authenticated_client=true, finite future token expiry and actual context.read; admin does not bypass these. PolicyService/configured policy and decision audit apply twice. Reader copies/fixes request context/input, independently authorizes exact target before storage and after second router authorization, comparing complete normalized grants including original expiry. Missing/null row still requires final authorization before404. Store exceptions collapse to OPERATION_UNAVAILABLE503; current-authority exceptions to DENIED403. Invalid decoded projection can fail before second authorization, but never returns source body.
x-runtime-boundaries.opa: Per-request private bearer scope; reread OIDC identity/capability and current object OPA decision on each call. Exact HTTPS /v1/data/planemem/session_current/decision and configured revision; no redirects/credentials/cache,5s abort signal per decision,8KiB strict UTF8 JSON, no content-encoding, case-insensitive unique known keys. Decision target/config/policy digest/future integer expiry must match and not extend token. identity_digest binds identity and bearer hash; authorization_ref binds URL/revision/policy digest/resource, while full grant separately binds challenge/trace. Identity/grant change denies. Generic alternate authority is an explicit embedded port, not production evidence.
x-runtime-boundaries.direct-store: READ COMMITTED read-only transaction, statement_timeout5s/lock_timeout2s. Exact session/tenant/workspace/project/actor/client row and existing undeleted project of public/internal/confidential classification in one SELECT. Restricted deliberately invisible even with extra capability. Missing/other owner/hidden project all null=>404 after final auth. Exact SQL-generated business JSON<=64KiB; safe version, complete strict projection, millisecond timestamps, <=256 references. Invalid/null oversized projection at store becomes503; malformed copied snapshot at reader becomes OPERATION_RESULT_INVALID400. No session-service Map/original-operation result/cache lookup; no lock keeping row unchanged.
x-runtime-boundaries.origin-bridge: When explicitly configured, replaces direct store with SessionOriginBridge using one REPEATABLE READ read-only transaction, no fallback. Requires current ABP-owned selection/approval, preserved legacy attempts/receipt/fingerprint, migration inventory and current row binding, matching start/parent and no resume_origin. Bridge read failure, including missing current/original row, yields503 instead of direct null404. Supplies source expiry and final revalidate callback after outer last current grant. Current-only HTTP output does not expose original records/selection or become original-proof endpoint; final revalidate checks approval, not another database row read.
x-runtime-boundaries.deadline: Per-reader Date.now plus performance.now30s budget starts after entry auth/body/policy/audit. Clock rollback or >=30s=>OPERATION_UNAVAILABLE503; token/source expiry or disconnect flag=>DENIED403 at guard. Guard order can make expiry/cancellation win. No current-reader timer/Promise.race or forced cancellation of pool queue/store/custom authority; waits finish then guard rejects. OPA adapter uses request signal; direct PostgreSQL adapter does not consume it. Response authorization expiry=min token/grant/optional source; not automatically capped to reader30s. No dedicated2-slot capacity; generic actor/path limiter only.
x-runtime-boundaries.response: Hash exact session_json UTF8, preserving source formatting; six row identity fields match target. Copy snapshot before asynchronous reauthorization. Preserve historical session trace/sources separately from current outer trace/session reference. All lifecycle states readable;200 is not execution permission. Generic success cache bypassed even with identical challenge/key; no nonce ledger or replay-proof guarantee. No dedicated outer response byte limit/ETag;64KiB limits embedded source text only.
x-runtime-boundaries.audit: Actual router decision audit before read and after valid snapshot/null read; configured durable sink failure prevents success. Generic audit sink errors503 retryable=true. Callback failures are not always wrapped. This read does not mint a durable export-release receipt or prove client delivery.
x-runtime-boundaries.client: No dedicated WcpClient/Mock machine-contract consumer added. External consumer must bind complete request/current identity/configuration/trace/challenge, independently bound/decode/validate response and session_json, recompute raw hash and enforce expiry/lifecycle policy. Existing internal projection parser trusts typed SQL JSON and is not an arbitrary remote raw-JSON duplicate-key parser. No original creation, factory approval or execution authority inferred.

post.summary: Observe one exact current session projection with current authority
post.description: Exactly five flat string fields. Independently authenticated current scope/client and current authority required. Same key/challenge rereads; does not write a session or prove nonce freshness. Requested media type describes expected JSON bytes; Gateway does not enforce Content-Type on this route.

TenantId.name: x-tenant-id
TenantId.description: Exact authorized scope. All three scope headers required; never identity grants.

TraceId.name: x-trace-id
TraceId.description: Nonempty value has first priority on session-source paths. Exact returned observation trace; no comparison against also-supplied traceparent.

TraceParent.name: traceparent
TraceParent.description: Opaque fallback only if x-trace-id empty/absent; otherwise ignored. If both empty/absent, generate trace_http_<ULID>.

Success.description: Complete current-only envelope, exact raw projection SHA256 and earliest authorization expiry. No ETag; source64KiB budget is not full response cap.

Error.description: Application error, no usable partial source. Parsed-body/auth/private-scope errors can omit x-trace-id and use private,no-store; ApiGateway responses include trace header and no-store. All are noncacheable. Disconnect can produce no response. No dedicated error byte cap.

x-trace-id.description: Optional on early errors; retain envelope trace. Invalid inbound traces may appear in errors.

BadInputOrSnapshot.description: INVALID_JSON400 false before authentication for raw UTF8/duplicate/flat-shape/4KiB failures. INVALID_REQUEST_CONTEXT400 false for fields/configuration/target. OPERATION_RESULT_INVALID400 false for invalid copied source/projection/source expiry; existing generic mapper does not map it500. SQL source oversize/nonmillisecond failure instead503. No413/422 guarantee.

Unauthenticated.description: UNAUTHENTICATED401 false for missing/invalid bearer; verifier configuration/availability instead503. No raw-header fallback.

Denied.description: DENIED403 false for scope/client/expected identity, entry/final policy, absent actual context.read/future expiry, independent current-authority error/changed grant, expired token/source or cancellation guard. Private identity scope outer catch also403; no provider token/error text exposed by authority.

NotFound.description: Direct store null (missing/wrong owner/hidden project) returns NOT_FOUND404 false only after final policy/audit/current authority. Explicit bridge failures instead503. Malformed provider snapshot is not mapped to a missing row.

RateLimited.description: Generic actor/path RATE_LIMITED429 true; no Retry-After or per-handler concurrency guarantee.

InternalError.description: Unexpected uncaught command/audit callback failure serializes INTERNAL_ERROR500 retryable=true. Reader's explicit invalid result uses400, not500.

Unavailable.description: OPERATION_UNAVAILABLE503 false: absent reader/authority, failed storage/bridge/final origin revalidation, backward clock or elapsed window. WORKBENCH_AUTH_UNAVAILABLE and configured decision AUDIT_PERSISTENCE_UNAVAILABLE503 true. No408/504 or universal retryable=true promise; repeated request is a new observation.
